title: One frame contract for every engine
chose: A single contract where an engine draws the frame at time t

over.name: A separate command set per engine
over.why: Each renderer would need its own stills, previews, checks and masters.

over.name: A plugin API for each renderer
over.why: It would tie Thesium to the internals of each engine instead of to what it can draw.

because: Every other feature rests on drawing one frame. A new engine gets the whole studio by implementing frame alone.
tradeoff: An engine that cannot draw one frame on demand cannot join. Some engines need a slow path for it.
